function.name: click
function.description:
[ACTION] Tap once (or repeatedly on the SAME point via times=2, etc.) and release immediately.

• Use for: buttons, links, checkboxes, tabs, icons, or double-tapping a single spot.
• Do NOT use for: focusing a field before typing (call input_text directly — it focuses the field itself), pressing and holding (use long_press), dragging (use drag_and_drop or drag_and_hold), or tapping multiple DIFFERENT points rapidly in one burst.

target.description: Tap target: an element index integer (e.g. 3) OR a 2-integer normalized coordinate pair [x, y] in 0-1000 scale (e.g. [500, 600]). Never pass a single coordinate number.

target_description.description: What the target is, in a few words (e.g. 'play button', 'search input', 'video body'). REQUIRED when target is a coordinate pair; ignored for an element index.

times.description: Number of consecutive taps on this SAME target (e.g. 2 for double-tap, 7 for developer mode). Default is 1.

delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between consecutive taps when times > 1. Default is 100.

function.name: input_text
function.description:
[ACTION] Focus (tap) the target input field, optionally clear existing text, and type text into it (supports multi-line strings with '\n').

• Use for: entering text into search bars, forms, or chat boxes in ONE step — do NOT call click on the input field first.
• Note: input_text does NOT press Enter/Submit automatically; follow with press_key(key='ENTER') or click the search/submit button if needed.

text.description: The text content to type. Supports multi-line content with '\n'.

target.description: Input field target: an element index integer (e.g. 3) OR a 2-integer normalized coordinate pair [x, y] in 0-1000 scale (e.g. [500, 600]).

target_description.description: What the target is, in a few words (e.g. 'play button', 'search input', 'video body'). REQUIRED when target is a coordinate pair; ignored for an element index.

clear_exist.description: Whether to clear existing text before typing. True (default): clear/replace entire text. False: append at the end of existing content.

function.name: swipe
function.description:
[ACTION] Perform an immediate single-finger swipe gesture (DOWN -> MOVE -> UP, with NO initial press delay).

• Mode 1 — Directional Scroll (pass 'direction', optional 'target'): Standard list/page scrolling ('up' reveals content below, 'down' reveals content above, 'left'/'right' switch pages/tabs). Automatically computes safe vectors with ~40% visual overlap.
• Mode 2 — Coordinate Swipe (pass 'start', 'end', and 'target_description'): Immediate local motions with NO press delay — adjusting an already-active slider/SeekBar (volume, brightness, progress bar), pull-to-refresh, or scrolling a custom container. Swipe slightly PAST the desired slider value (or to the extreme edge for 0%/100%). Do NOT mix Mode 1 and Mode 2.
• Do NOT use swipe for:
  - Pinch-to-zoom or two-finger rotation: strictly single-touch! For zoom, use single-touch UI controls (zoom presets like '1x'/'2x', holding or dragging a zoom control, '+'/'-' buttons, or double-tap).
  - Drag-and-drop, icon/list reordering, or controls requiring an initial press delay: if swipe has no effect, switch to drag_and_drop (known visible destination), drag_and_hold + drop_after_hold (control/drop zone stays open only while pressed), or long_press.

direction.description: Mode 1 (scroll/page switch): 'up' (reveal content below), 'down' (reveal content above), 'left' (scroll right), 'right' (scroll left). Omit when using start/end.

start.description: Mode 2 start [x, y] in 0-1000 scale for immediate local motions without press delay (already-active slider, SeekBar, custom scrollable container). Omit when using direction.

end.description: Mode 2 end [x, y] in 0-1000 scale. Required with start; omit when using direction.

target.description: Optional Mode 1 container scope: element index (e.g. 2) or bounds [left, top, right, bottom] to scroll inside.

gesture.description: Legacy alias (prefer 'direction' or 'start'+'end'): direction string OR 4-integer list [start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y].

target_description.description: What is being swiped, in a few words (e.g. 'brightness slider knob'). REQUIRED for Mode 2 coordinate swipes; ignored for Mode 1 directional scrolling.

duration.description: Optional swipe duration in milliseconds (default 800; computed automatically for directional swipes).

function.name: drag_and_drop
function.description:
[ACTION] Press (initial press delay hold_ms), move an item from start to end, and RELEASE in one continuous turn (DOWN -> DELAY -> MOVE -> UP).

• Use for: moving icons/widgets, drag-and-drop between containers, or reordering list items when the final drop destination is ALREADY visible. Do NOT call long_press before this tool — hold_ms is already built in.
• Do NOT use for:
  - Drop zones or continuous controls ('Remove'/'Uninstall' bar, folder creation, edge page switching, continuous camera zoom slider) that ONLY appear or need live visual adjustment while pressed: use drag_and_hold + drop_after_hold instead (drag_and_drop releases at the end and dismisses transient controls).
  - Immediate scrolling or sliders without press delay: if hold_ms opens a context/selection menu instead of moving, switch to swipe (or retry with hold_ms=0).

start.description: Start location to press and pick up from: element index integer (e.g. 3) OR normalized [x, y] pair (e.g. [500, 600]).

end.description: Final drop destination where the finger releases: element index integer (e.g. 7) OR normalized [x, y] pair (e.g. [200, 400]).

target_description.description: What is being picked up and dragged, in a few words (e.g. 'Chrome app icon', 'playlist item'). REQUIRED when start is a coordinate pair; ignored when start is an element index.

hold_ms.description: Initial press delay in milliseconds at start before moving (e.g. 1000 for 1s, 0 for immediate start). Default is 1000.

duration_ms.description: Duration of the movement from start to end in milliseconds after the initial press delay. Default is 400.

function.name: drag_and_hold
function.description:
[ACTION] Press (initial press delay hold_ms) and drag from start to end WITHOUT releasing the finger (DOWN -> DELAY -> MOVE; finger stays pressed across turns until drop_after_hold is called).

• Use for: targets or continuous controls that ONLY appear or need live visual feedback while the finger stays pressed — 'Remove'/'Uninstall' bars, edge page switching, folder creation, or pressing and sliding a camera '1x'/'2x' zoom control to adjust a continuous zoom slider. Do NOT call long_press first — hold_ms is already built in.
• Multi-turn rule: the next screenshot is captured while pressed; call drag_and_hold again to keep adjusting without lifting, and ALWAYS finish with drop_after_hold.
• Do NOT use for: destinations already visible that can finish in 1 turn (use drag_and_drop), or immediate slides/scrolls (if hold_ms opens a context menu instead of moving, switch to swipe or retry with hold_ms=0).

start.description: Start location to press and begin dragging from: element index integer (e.g. 3) OR normalized [x, y] pair (e.g. [500, 600]).

end.description: Intermediate location to move to while keeping the finger pressed (often offset 50-100 units from start to enter drag mode or open a continuous control): element index (int) OR normalized [x, y] pair.

target_description.description: What is being picked up and held, in a few words (e.g. 'Chrome app icon', '1x zoom button'). REQUIRED when start is a coordinate pair; ignored when start is an element index.

hold_ms.description: Initial press delay in milliseconds at start before moving (e.g. 1000 for 1s, 0 for immediate drag). Default is 1000.

duration_ms.description: Duration of the movement from start to end in milliseconds after the initial press delay. Default is 400.

function.name: drop_after_hold
function.description:
[ACTION] Move an actively held drag_and_hold touch to an optional target and RELEASE the finger (MOVE -> UP).

• Use ONLY after drag_and_hold, once the revealed drop zone ('Remove', 'Uninstall', folder) is visible or the held slider has reached the target value. Omit target to release in place.
• Do NOT call after long_press, drag_and_drop, or swipe — those already released the finger and drop_after_hold will fail.

target.description: Optional drop destination: element index integer (e.g. 2) OR normalized [x, y] pair (e.g. [500, 100]). Omit to release in place at the currently held position.

target_description.description: What the drop destination is, in a few words (e.g. 'Remove zone', 'Uninstall button'). REQUIRED when target is a coordinate pair; ignored for an element index or in-place release.

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds to move from the currently held position to target before releasing. Default is 400.

function.name: press_key
function.description:
[ACTION] Press one of the 4 supported Android system keys: ONLY 'ENTER', 'BACK', 'HOME', or 'APP_SWITCH'.

• Use for: submitting search/text ('ENTER'), navigating back ('BACK'), returning to the home screen ('HOME'), or opening recent apps ('APP_SWITCH').
• Do NOT pass unsupported keys (such as VOLUME_UP, VOLUME_DOWN, POWER, MENU, or DELETE) — only the 4 enum values above are accepted.

key.description: Exact system key name — ONLY 'ENTER', 'BACK', 'HOME', or 'APP_SWITCH'.

function.name: manage_app
function.description:
[ACTION] Launch or force-stop an application directly by display name or package name.

• Use for: opening, switching to, or resetting an app (prefer manage_app over manually hunting for icons on the home screen or app drawer).

app_name.description: Display name (e.g. 'Camera', 'Settings') or Android package name (e.g. 'com.android.settings').

function.name: wait_for_delay
function.description:
[ACTION] Pause execution for time_in_ms milliseconds without touching the screen.

• Use for: active loading/splash screens, animations, transitions, or explicit wait intervals required by the task.
• Do NOT loop wait_for_delay on a static screen — if nothing changes after 1-2 waits, take a different action instead.

time_in_ms.description: Wait duration in milliseconds (e.g. 2000 for 2s, 5000 for 5s, 60000 for 1 minute).

function.name: long_press
function.description:
[ACTION] Press and hold in place for duration ms, then RELEASE the finger (DOWN -> WAIT -> UP).

• Use for: opening context menus, entering multi-select mode, showing app-icon shortcuts, or opening the home-screen customization menu (on an empty wallpaper area).
• Do NOT use for:
  - Starting a drag, moving/resizing/removing icons or widgets, or holding before drop_after_hold: long_press ALWAYS releases the finger at the end! Call drag_and_drop or drag_and_hold + drop_after_hold directly instead (they already include the initial press delay hold_ms).
  - Opening a transient control (such as a camera zoom dial) that auto-dismisses before the next turn: use a continuous drag_and_hold + drop_after_hold (or drag_and_drop) from the trigger instead.
  - Never repeat long_press on the same target just changing duration if 1-2 attempts show no progress — switch to a different tool or target.

target.description: Long press target: an element index integer (e.g. 3) OR a 2-integer normalized coordinate pair [x, y] in 0-1000 scale (e.g. [500, 600]).

target_description.description: What the target is, in a few words (e.g. 'play button', 'search input', 'video body'). REQUIRED when target is a coordinate pair; ignored for an element index.

duration.description: Press duration in milliseconds before releasing (default 1000).
